tests.code: from aliens import min_total_cells; n,m,k=5,7,2; pts=[(0,3),(4,4),(4,6),(4,5),(4,6)]; assert min_total_cells(n,m,k,pts)==25
from aliens import min_total_cells; n,m,k=2,6,2; pts=[(1,4),(4,1)]; assert min_total_cells(n,m,k,pts)==16
from aliens import min_total_cells; n,m,k=1,5,1; pts=[(2,2)]; assert min_total_cells(n,m,k,pts)==1
from aliens import min_total_cells; n,m,k=4,10,2; pts=[(5,5),(5,5),(5,5),(6,6)]; assert min_total_cells(n,m,k,pts)==2
from aliens import min_total_cells; n,m,k=5,12,5; pts=[(0,0),(0,5),(5,5),(7,7),(11,11)]; assert min_total_cells(n,m,k,pts)==5

tests.description: k=1 必须一个大正方形全包
tests.code: from aliens import min_total_cells; n,m,k=5,12,1; pts=[(0,0),(0,5),(5,5),(7,7),(11,11)]; assert min_total_cells(n,m,k,pts)==144
from aliens import min_total_cells; n,m,k=2,7,1; pts=[(0,2),(2,0)]; assert min_total_cells(n,m,k,pts)==9

tests.description: 对称近对角线（同一 2×2 可覆盖）
tests.code: from aliens import min_total_cells; n,m,k=2,6,1; pts=[(2,3),(3,2)]; assert min_total_cells(n,m,k,pts)==4

tests.description: k 变化的效应：两点在对角线上
tests.code: from aliens import min_total_cells; n,m=2,6; pts=[(2,2),(3,3)]; assert min_total_cells(n,m,1,pts)==4 and min_total_cells(n,m,2,pts)==2

tests.description: 两簇相距较远：k=2 显著优于 k=1
tests.code: from aliens import min_total_cells; m=12; pts=[(0,0),(0,1),(1,1),(5,5)]; assert min_total_cells(4,m,2,pts)==5 and min_total_cells(4,m,1,pts)==36

tests.description: 已在对角线上的多点，k=1 选最小包络正方形
tests.code:
from aliens import min_total_cells; n,m,k=3,20,1; pts=[(2,2),(5,5),(9,9)]; # 覆盖 [2,9] => 8x8=64
assert min_total_cells(n,m,k,pts)==64

tests.description: 混合点：1×1 + 2×2 的组合更优于单大方形
tests.code:
from aliens import min_total_cells; n,m,k=3,10,2; pts=[(2,2),(2,3),(9,9)]; # (2,2)/(2,3) 用 [2,4] 2x2=4, (9,9) 用 1 => 5
assert min_total_cells(n,m,k,pts)==5
